name: hinty-agents-desktop
description: Hinty Agents desktop app: pair this computer with your Hinty account, switch away-from-desk mode, connect your AI coding agents. Bundles Node.js, so nothing else needs to be installed.
author: Hinty <support@hinty.eu> (https://www.hinty.eu)

scripts.dist:win: node scripts/stage.mjs --platform win32 --arch x64 && electron-builder --win nsis --x64 --config electron-builder.yml
scripts.dist:mac:arm64: node scripts/stage.mjs --platform darwin --arch arm64 && electron-builder --mac dmg --arm64 --config electron-builder.yml
scripts.dist:mac:x64: node scripts/stage.mjs --platform darwin --arch x64 && electron-builder --mac dmg --x64 --config electron-builder.yml
